description: This file contains unit tests for the ViewMetadata class within the SuiteCRM project, especially focusing on display functions and module/field retrieval methods.

classes.name: ViewMetadataTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ViewMetadata class functions in SuiteCRM, including display methods and module/field retrieval.

methods.name: testdisplayCheckBoxes
methods.description: Tests the displayCheckBoxes() method for rendering HTML with empty and prefilled values.

methods.name: testdisplaySelect
methods.description: Tests the displaySelect() method for correct HTML rendering with different values.

methods.name: testdisplayTextBoxes
methods.description: Tests the displayTextBoxes() method for output correctness with empty and prefilled data.

methods.name: testprintValue
methods.description: Verifies that printValue() outputs some content given an array of values.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Evaluates the overall display() method behavior with and without REQUEST parameters.

methods.name: testgetModules
methods.description: Checks that getModules() returns an array of module names.

methods.name: testfindFieldsWithAttributes
methods.description: Tests findFieldsWithAttributes() with various attribute filters to ensure different results.

methods.name: testfindVardefs
methods.description: Ensures findVardefs() returns an array for empty and specific module inputs.

methods.name: testfindFieldAttributes
methods.description: Checks findFieldAttributes() returns arrays and differentiates between various attribute filters.
